items.stem: The figure above shows a sunlight reflector installed on the roof of a building. At the instant shown, sunlight falls at an angle of 30° to the horizontal and is then reflected vertically into the building. What is the angle between the reflector and the horizontal?
items.hint: Incident ray is 30° to the horizontal and the reflected ray is vertical. Angle of incidence equals angle of reflection, so the reflector is 60° to the horizontal.
